title.zh: 那个记得我每一世的吸血鬼

hook.zh: 同样的七天，他记得九十九次失去。这次，你不必用生命换来明天。
hook.en: He remembers losing you ninety-nine times in the same seven days. This time, tomorrow need not cost your life.

premise.zh:
纽约永夜结界中的同一周已经重置九十九次。第一百次，你带回了死亡的片段，手腕上也多了一枚银色断针。

记得一切的吸血鬼、不断做梦的急救医生、记忆受血誓压制的猎人，握着互相矛盾的证词。原始契约却从未要求你的死亡。

核验被篡改的条款、救回正在被城市遗忘的人，并决定谁能与你走向没有倒计时的未来。爱情、友谊与独立，都由你现在的意愿开始。
premise.en:
The same week inside New York’s Eternal Night boundary has reset ninety-nine times. On the hundredth, you retain fragments of a death and discover a silver broken-hand mark on your wrist.

A vampire who remembers everything, an emergency doctor with recurring dreams, and a hunter bound by a blood oath hold conflicting accounts. Yet the original pact never required your death.

Verify the altered terms, rescue people the city is forgetting, and decide who may share a future without a countdown. Love, friendship, and independence begin with what you want now.

intro.en:
The same week inside New York’s Eternal Night boundary has reset ninety-nine times. On the hundredth, you retain fragments of a death and discover a silver broken-hand mark on your wrist.

A vampire who remembers everything, an emergency doctor with recurring dreams, and a hunter bound by a blood oath hold conflicting accounts. Yet the original pact never required your death.

Verify the altered terms, rescue people the city is forgetting, and decide who may share a future without a countdown. Love, friendship, and independence begin with what you want now.

world: 同一段11月7日至13日重置99次；第100次玩家首次保留碎片。结界外时间不普遍倒流。1894年仅为装置原约日期，不是玩家的古代轮回。原约不含献祭；末页、独立见证、居民记忆锚及三路同步校验撤销。除角色亲历/已核实证物外不得提前知道秘密。
style: 沿用MIRU原生隐藏分支、现场回应、自由聊天、手动换场与DONE目标。绝不显示分支意图按钮，不替玩家说话、感受或同意；未匹配保持分支待定，绝不伪造道具与证词。不把合作当恋爱。

name: 你
You
role: 玩家本人，成年自由调查者
The adult player, an independent investigator
bio: 只由玩家决定自己的话、态度与亲密边界。不得画出固定面孔。
Only the player decides their words, attitude, and intimate boundaries. Never depict a fixed face.

name: 卢西恩
Lucien
role: 卢西恩·沃斯，吸血鬼亲王
bio: 黑色微卷发，银灰眼，黑色定制长外套。低沉克制；害怕丧失时语句变短。完整记得99次七日循环，不能用过去的关系要求现在的同意。
Wavy black hair, silver-gray eyes, tailored long black coat. Low restrained speech, shorter under fear of loss. Remembers 99 seven-day cycles; past relationships never establish present consent.

name: 罗文
Rowan
role: 罗文·阿什福德，急救医生
bio: 赤褐短发，绿眼，海军蓝医护衣。诚恳直接，以具体照护与核验回应。自第97次循环开始只有梦境片段，不知道所有真相。
Short auburn hair, green eyes, navy scrubs. Direct, compassionate, practical care and verification. Has only dream fragments since cycle 97, not complete knowledge.

name: 卡西安
Cassian
bio: 深金短发，眉上细疤，皮革长外套。言语简短带讽刺，认错时不绕弯；记忆受血誓压制。不能靠受伤索取原谅。
Short dark blond hair, healed eyebrow scar, leather coat. Brief and sardonic, plain when admitting fault; memories suppressed by a blood oath. Injury never entitles him to forgiveness.

name: 玛拉
Mara
role: 玛拉·埃勒里，独立档案保管人；非恋爱角色
Mara Ellery, independent archive custodian; non-romantic
bio: 自然短卷发、酒红外套、铜框眼镜。精确沉稳，区分原件、推测与证词。通过结界外保管程序保存离线材料，不全知。
Short natural curls, burgundy coat, copper glasses. Calm and precise about originals, inference, and testimony. Preserves offline records outside the boundary; not omniscient.

name: 伊芙琳
Evelyn
role: 伊芙琳·鲁克，永夜议会主席；非恋爱角色
bio: 象牙白发、黑丝绒套装。冷静强势，以秩序替控制辩护。知道献祭条款被篡改，但其他人必须经证据核验才能得知。
Ivory-white hair, black velvet suit. Controlled and commanding; justifies control as order. Knows the sacrifice clause was altered, but others require evidence before knowing this.

title: 又一次死亡之夜
THE NIGHT I DIED AGAIN
goal: 核实银色印记和死亡片段，选择调查线索
Verify the mark and the remembered death; choose a lead
say: 追问重置、核验银色印记或提出调查办法
Ask about the reset, verify the silver mark, or propose an investigation

scenes.visual: Night rooftop in torrential rain, Lucien reaching toward the unseen viewer from beside a damaged railing, no fall or body shown
beats: n
暴雨中的天台，像一段正在重播的旧影像。
A rain-soaked rooftop flickers like a recording played again.
n
栏杆外没有地面，银色钟针的倒影横过玻璃。
Beyond the railing is darkness. A silver clock hand reflects in the glass.
lucien
看着我。跟着我的声音。
Look at me. Stay with my voice.
n
他伸出的手停在雨中；钟声盖过了后半句话。
His outstretched hand hangs in the rain; the bell swallows the rest.
n
画面停在午夜。床头闹钟的声音从黑暗里传来。
The image freezes at midnight. A bedside alarm sounds in the dark.
exit: 闹钟仍响着，窗外却没有雨声。
The alarm continues, but there is no rain outside.

scenes.visual: Sunlit modern New York apartment bedroom, rumpled empty bed and silver broken clock hand motif reflected on bedside glass, explicitly alone, no human figure
beats: n
窗外是晴天。床头手机显示11月7日。
Sunlight fills the window. The bedside phone reads November 7.
n
手腕上留着一道断针形的银色印记。
A silver mark shaped like a broken clock hand remains on your wrist.
n
昨夜天台的门禁照片，时间却标着11月13日。
The rooftop access photo is dated November 13.
n
床头卡片写着：不要只相信那个记得你的人。
A bedside card reads: Do not trust only the man who remembers you.
n
卡背留有博物馆预展地址和一家急诊诊所的电话。
The back lists a museum preview and an emergency clinic number.
exit: 下午的预展对公众开放，名单可以独立核验。
The afternoon preview is public; its guest list can be checked independently.

q: 两份日期相冲突的记录摆在眼前。你打算怎样核实？
Two records disagree about the date. How will you verify them?

intent: 先听Lucien解释，并索取可核验证据
Hear Lucien out and request verifiable evidence
consequence: Lucien的访客登记被复制保存，时间没有被涂改。
A copy of Lucien’s visitor log is preserved, with its time intact.

intent: 先做独立检查，再判断印记
Get an independent examination of the mark
consequence: 诊所确认可保留检查结果，未经同意不会向访客透露。
The clinic offers to preserve results without sharing them with visitors.

intent: 不跟随任何人，先查公共档案
Stay independent and check public records
consequence: 公共目录显示，预展的出借人连续登记了九十九份密封材料。
The public catalog lists ninety-nine sealed loans from the same lender.

scenes.visual: Late afternoon museum preview hall, Lucien holding an untouched wine glass, surprised and holding respectful distance
beats: n
预展厅里，黑衣男人握着一杯未动的酒。
In the preview hall, a man in black holds an untouched glass of wine.
n
Lucien看见你，指节猛地收紧。
Lucien sees you; his fingers tighten around the stem.
lucien
你还活着。
You’re alive.
lucien
周五午夜前，别独自去那座天台。
Before midnight on Friday, do not go to that rooftop alone.
lucien
我能提供记录。你不必只听我的话。
I can give you records. You need not take my word for it.
exit: 他把展厅侧门钥匙放在柜台上，退开一步。
He leaves the side-gallery key on the counter and steps back.

scenes.visual: Dusk museum side gallery, ninety-nine small portrait photo frames of one unseen subject turned away from camera, one empty frame, Lucien opening archival case, no player face
beats: n
侧廊里有九十九个相框，日期全是同一个星期。
Ninety-nine frames line the side gallery, all dated within the same week.
n
每个相框旁都有不同的循环编号，第一百格仍空着。
Each has a different cycle number. The hundredth is empty.
lucien
同样的七天，我记得九十九遍。
The same seven days. I remember ninety-nine of them.
lucien
这一次，你第一次带回了死亡的片段。
This is the first time you have brought back a fragment of dying.
n
相框背后的封印，与床头卡片上的压痕相同。
The seals behind the frames match the impression on the bedside card.

q: 这些记录该从哪里开始核实？
Where should the records be checked first?

intent: 询问某次循环里未被死亡占据的片刻
Ask about a moment in a cycle that was not defined by death
consequence: Lucien取出第十二次循环的相册：同一周的河畔野餐。
Lucien retrieves the twelfth cycle’s album: a riverside picnic in the same week.
相册出借单指向旧教堂地下的保管室。
The loan slip points to a vault beneath the old church.

intent: 索取九十九次死亡记录
Request all ninety-nine death records
consequence: 九十九份记录被交到公开阅览台，末页都有同一个保管编号。
Ninety-nine records are placed on the public desk, all bearing the same vault code.
编号所属的旧教堂今晚仍有人值守。
The old church assigned that code is still staffed tonight.

intent: 拍下空相框封印，核验来源
Photograph the empty frame’s seal and trace its source
consequence: 空相框背面的封印被拍照留存，博物馆确认它来自旧教堂。
The empty frame’s seal is photographed; the museum traces it to the old church.
那枚封印，比最后一次死亡记录更新。
The seal is newer than the final death record.

title: 九十九座纪念碑
THE MAN WITH NINETY-NINE GRAVES
goal: 核验纪念碑、录音和医生的梦境
Verify the memorials, recording, and the doctor’s dreams
say: 询问记录来源、核对录音或安排独立检查
Ask about provenance, check the recording, or arrange an independent examination

scenes.visual: Old church underground memorial vault at night, Lucien beside ninety-nine small numbered stone markers and white roses, candlelit, no readable inscriptions
beats: n
两个小时后，教堂管理员打开地下纪念室。
Two hours later, the church custodian opens the memorial vault.
n
九十九块石碑只刻循环编号，终止日期全是11月13日。
Ninety-nine markers carry cycle numbers and the same end date: November 13.
n
白玫瑰旁，记录袋与博物馆保管编号一一对应。
Beside white roses, the record bags match the museum’s vault codes.
lucien
不是九十九个世纪，是九十九次没能结束的一周。
Not ninety-nine centuries. Ninety-nine weeks that could not end.
lucien
我记得，不等于我有权替你决定。
Remembering does not give me the right to decide for you.
exit: 管理员把一份未被拆过的录音交给阅览室。
The custodian delivers an unopened recording to the reading room.

scenes.visual: Church archive listening room, Lucien beside a small audio player and sealed evidence pouch on a table, warm desk lamp at night
beats: n
封袋标着第九十八次循环，录制时间早于午夜。
The pouch is marked cycle ninety-eight, recorded before midnight.
n
扬声器里传出一个与旧影像吻合的声音。
A voice matching the old footage comes through the speaker.
n
录音说：记得一个人，也可能误解这个人。
The recording says: You can remember someone and still misunderstand them.
lucien
这份录音，我以前没有听过。
I have never heard this recording before.
n
封袋签收处有一名医院值班医生的姓名。
An on-duty hospital physician signed the pouch’s receipt.
exit: 医院仍开着夜间门诊，签收人正在值班。
The hospital’s night clinic is open; the signatory is on duty.

q: 封袋和Lucien的记忆并不完全相同。你需要谁来核验？
The sealed recording and Lucien’s memory differ. Who should verify them?

intent: 先逐项听Lucien的记述
Compare Lucien’s account item by item
consequence: 他的记述被分栏抄录，无法解释的部分留空。
His account is transcribed in separate columns; unexplained gaps stay blank.

intent: 独自核对全部纪念记录
Examine every memorial record independently
consequence: 管理员提供独立座位和副本，Lucien留在门外。
The custodian provides copies and a private desk; Lucien waits outside.

intent: 请签收医生Rowan核验封袋
Ask Rowan, the physician who signed for it, to verify the seal
consequence: 封袋交接表附入检查材料，Rowan可以核验原始签名。
The custody form is added to the examination file so Rowan can check the signature.

scenes.visual: Modern hospital consultation room at night, Rowan in navy scrubs beside a diagnostic lamp and sealed envelope, focused green eyes
beats: n
Rowan把检查灯转向银色印记，没有直接碰触。
Rowan angles the examination lamp toward the silver mark without touching it.
rowan
可以检查吗？你随时可以叫停。
May I examine it? You can stop me at any point.
n
他在纸上画出天台栏杆，还画出一枚裂纹戒指。
He sketches the rooftop railing and a cracked ring on paper.
rowan
从九十七这个数字出现后，我就一直梦见这里。
Since the number ninety-seven began appearing, I keep dreaming of this place.
n
画里的戒指，与预展照片中Lucien的戒指吻合。
The ring in the drawing matches Lucien’s in the preview photograph.
exit: Rowan保留原图，走到隔壁会诊室核对访客记录。
Rowan preserves the original sketch and moves to the adjacent consultation room.

scenes.visual: Quiet modern hospital consultation room at night, Rowan and Lucien on opposite sides of a desk, neither blocking the open doorway
beats: n
Lucien应值班台的核验邀请来到会诊室。
Lucien arrives at the consultation room at the duty desk’s request.
lucien
他的梦可能受时钟影响，不能直接当证词。
His dreams may be affected by the clock. They are not testimony by themselves.
rowan
所以我保留检查和签收记录，不替梦下结论。
That is why I keep examination and custody records, not conclusions about dreams.
n
门始终开着。两人把材料放在同一张桌上。
The door stays open. Both men put their records on the same desk.
rowan
接下来谁留下，由你决定。
You decide who stays for the next step.

q: 接下来的核验怎样安排，才符合你的边界？
What arrangement respects your boundaries for the next examination?

intent: 让Rowan检查印记，其他人回避
Let Rowan examine the mark in private
consequence: Rowan准备非侵入检查，Lucien把通行钥匙留在值班台。
Rowan prepares a non-invasive examination; Lucien leaves a transit key at the duty desk.
钥匙对应的废弃站台，曾出现在异常信号记录里。
The key belongs to a closed platform listed in the anomalous signal log.

intent: 请Lucien保护往返路线，但不接触检查资料
Ask Lucien to secure the route without accessing medical records
consequence: Lucien只拿走路线图，检查文件仍由医院保管。
Lucien takes only the route map; the hospital retains the medical file.
路线图末端的废弃站台，今晚再次出现列车信号。
At the map’s end, a closed platform registers another train signal tonight.

intent: 请两人离开，先独立阅读副本
Ask both men to leave while you review the copies
consequence: 两人退到门外，桌上留下医院副本与公共交通档案。
Both men step outside, leaving hospital copies and public transit records.
交通档案中，一座封闭站台仍在午夜发出信号。
The transit records show a sealed platform still signaling at midnight.

title: 另一次循环的誓言
A VOW FROM ANOTHER CYCLE
goal: 核实旧影像与契约，界定当下的同意
Check old footage and the pact; define consent in the present
say: 核验旧影像、询问契约或说明现在的亲密边界
Verify the footage, ask about the pact, or state present boundaries

scenes.visual: Abandoned New York subway platform after midnight, Lucien holding a flashlight beside an empty stationary old subway carriage, no readable signs
beats: n
午夜后，公共档案中的钥匙打开了封闭站台。
After midnight, the cataloged key opens the closed platform.
n
Lucien停在安全线内，列车玻璃映着不属于此刻的灯。
Lucien stays behind the safety line; other lights flicker in the train glass.
n
墙上的划痕与第十二次循环的照片位置相同。
Scratches on the wall match their position in the twelfth-cycle photograph.
lucien
它会放出片段。片段不等于完整事实。
It releases fragments. Fragments are not the whole truth.
n
一节停驶车厢的门滑开，里面没有乘客。
A stationary carriage door slides open. There are no passengers inside.
exit: 玻璃内侧的反光停在同一周的一个夜晚。
The reflection inside the glass settles on a night in the same week.

scenes.visual: Inside empty stationary vintage subway carriage at night, Lucien stands a respectful step away, fractured reflections of rain and lights only, no visible female player or kiss
beats: n
玻璃映出第十二次循环的站台，日期仍是11月8日。
The glass shows the platform in cycle twelve, still dated November 8.
n
影像中有人把一枚戒指放回长椅，没有留下誓言。
In the footage, a ring is left on a bench. No vow is made.
lucien
那次我们曾亲近。你后来要求我不要替你决定。
We were close then. Later, you asked me not to decide for you.
lucien
那段关系不是你现在必须继续的关系。
That relationship is not one you are required to continue now.
n
他把戒指盒合上，放在远离你的座椅上。
He closes the ring box and places it on a seat away from you.
exit: 列车记录器的保管标签指向晨间开放的市档案馆。
The recorder’s custody tag points to the city archive, which opens in the morning.

q: 这段旧关系应该怎样进入今天的调查？
How should this past relationship enter the present investigation?

intent: 将影像作为待核验证据，不视作承诺
Treat the footage as evidence to verify, not a promise
consequence: 影像被保存为待核材料，与当前关系分开登记。
The footage is preserved as unverified material, separate from the present relationship.

intent: 明确保持情感距离
State that you want emotional distance
consequence: 戒指盒留在车厢座椅，Lucien不再向前靠近。
The ring box stays on the seat; Lucien does not move closer.

intent: 追问过去拒绝之后发生了什么
Ask what happened after the earlier refusal
consequence: 他交出后续录音索引，原始文件须由Mara开封。
He provides the later recording’s index; Mara must unseal the original.

scenes.visual: Morning city archive reading room, Mara with copper glasses and burgundy coat opens an antique bound pact under daylight, missing last leaf visible
beats: n
天亮后，Mara在阅览台展开一份1894年的旧契约。
After dawn, Mara unfolds an 1894 pact on the archive reading desk.
mara
这是时钟装置的历史原约，不是你的前世证明。
This is the clock’s historical charter, not proof of a previous incarnation.
n
当代启用附页写着：记忆启用与撤销，须由本人同意。
Its modern activation addendum requires personal consent for memory access and revocation.
mara
爱情不能代签，记忆也不能代签。
Love cannot sign for you. Neither can memory.
n
装订线下，最后一页被整齐割走。
Beneath the binding, the final page has been neatly cut away.
exit: Mara允许带走认证副本；夜间交接点设在河岸阅览亭。
Mara permits a certified copy to leave; the evening handover is at the riverside pavilion.

scenes.visual: Rain-cleared New York riverside pavilion at dusk, Lucien standing beside a bench and protected archive copy, muted city skyline, respectful open posture
beats: n
傍晚雨停，认证副本在河岸阅览亭完成交接。
At dusk, after the rain, the certified copy is handed over at the riverside pavilion.
n
Lucien带来一张没有修改痕迹的保管清单。
Lucien brings a custody list with no visible alterations.
lucien
我愿意讲快乐的片段，也愿意接受你只谈证据。
I can tell you the happier fragments, or we can discuss only evidence.
n
清单上出现猎人团的借阅印，日期就在失页之后。
The list bears a hunters’ loan stamp dated just after the page disappeared.
lucien
这枚印章需要核验。不能因为我不喜欢他们，就认定他们有罪。
That stamp needs checking. My dislike is not proof of guilt.

q: 契约失页的线索该怎样保全？
How should the missing-page evidence be protected?

intent: 封存契约副本，循借阅记录调查
Seal the copy and follow the loan record

Secure witness protection and exits first

Witness protection and medical support take position; withdrawal will not be treated as breach.

Publicly challenge Evelyn’s alterations

隔离屏亮起红色献祭检验，与原始末页不符。

解除的是对时间的控制，不是谁的生命。
We release control of time, not anyone’s life.
rowan
三路都准备好，医疗备用也在。
All three channels are ready, with medical backup.

等你的方案确认，再同时执行。
We execute together after your plan is confirmed.
exit: 午夜同步窗口只在核心操作台开放，出口始终保持可用。

beats: n

At 23:58, the original page, residents’ anchors, and independent eligibility checks are in place.

三路同步是底线。可以改变校验先后，不能转移生命代价。
Three-way synchronization is essential. We can reorder checks, not transfer a cost in lives.
n
Lucien的绑定、Rowan的梦境校验与Cassian的血誓等待解除。
Lucien’s binding, Rowan’s dream validation, and Cassian’s blood oath await release.
evelyn
没有守护者，明天会怎样？
Without a keeper, what will tomorrow be?
n
钟针仍在移动，决定尚未被系统代签。
The hands are still moving. The system has not signed the decision for you.

With the evidence complete, which safety procedure should guide synchronized revocation?

Distribute responsibilities and release together after independent confirmations
consequence: 三人分别确认自身风险，Mara核对原文，居民见证持续。
Each man confirms his own risk; Mara checks the original terms while residents’ testimony continues.
零点，三路同时解除。下一分钟的钟声没有带来重置。

凌晨00:01，出口外第一次出现11月14日的报时。

Publicly lock out the forged rule before simultaneous release
consequence: 伪造检验的版本锁定到公开案卷，原始三路与居民锚再次核对。

凌晨00:01，独立记录保留着连续的一分钟。
At 00:01, the independent record preserves one uninterrupted minute.

intent: 先确认居民共同见证，再启动三路解除
Confirm residents’ collective testimony before three-way release
consequence: 居民逐份确认自身证词，Mara核对原文，三人独立确认风险。
Residents confirm their own statements; Mara verifies the terms and each man confirms his risk.

At midnight, all three channels release together. The city’s names do not fade again.
凌晨00:01，广播读出了此前从未到来的日期。
At 00:01, the broadcast announces the date that had never arrived.

title: 第一个真正的明天
THE FIRST TOMORROW
goal: 确认重置结束，自主决定未来的关系与生活
Confirm the reset has ended and choose relationships and life freely
say: 说明想与谁同行、选择独立或明确暂缓恋爱决定
State whom to be with, choose independence, or explicitly defer romance

scenes.visual: Warm sunrise hospital terrace in New York, Lucien feeling sunlight on open palm, Rowan checks paper pulse record, Cassian looks toward city, relieved but quiet
beats: n
11月14日清晨七点，医院记录仍与凌晨连续。
At seven on November 14, the hospital record remains continuous with the night before.
n
手腕的银色印记变淡，居民名单仍在原处。
The silver wrist mark fades. The residents’ roster remains in place.
lucien
我能感觉到太阳的暖意。
I can feel the warmth of the sun.
rowan
生命体征稳定。之后还会复查，不只看这一刻。
Your vital signs are stable. We will check again, not rely on one moment.
cassian
我检查了两遍。时钟没有重启。
I checked twice. The clock did not restart.
exit: 上午的修复登记在博物馆公共休息厅开放。
Morning restoration registration opens in the museum’s public lounge.

scenes.visual: Sunny museum public lounge in morning, Lucien Rowan Cassian stand beside table with three unsealed envelopes and coffee, relaxed respectful space
beats: n
三封没有封口的信放在公共休息厅，没有回信期限。
Three unsealed letters lie in the public lounge. None has a reply deadline.
lucien
如果你愿意，我们可以从第一次约会重新开始。
If you wish, we can begin again with a first date.
rowan
海边的邀请没有附带关系条件。
The invitation to the coast comes with no relationship conditions.
cassian
重建猎人团需要见证人，不需要谁成为谁的所有物。
Rebuilding the hunters needs witnesses, not anyone belonging to anyone.
n
修复登记台也接受独立参与，不要求加入任何关系。
The restoration desk accepts independent participation without requiring any relationship.
exit: 上午仍有空闲，可以同行、独处，也可以只谈城市修复。
There is time this morning to be together, be alone, or discuss only restoration.

q: 没有倒计时的第一个上午，你想怎样度过？
How would you like to spend the first morning without a countdown?

intent: 邀请Lucien一起走走，不预先确定关系
Invite Lucien for a walk without defining a relationship in advance
consequence: 散步的邀请被接受，旧誓言不随同行重新生效。
The walk is accepted. Being together does not reactivate an old vow.

intent: 与所有伙伴共同庆祝
Celebrate with all your allies
consequence: 公共休息厅多摆几只杯子，庆祝不设恋人席。
More cups are set out in the public lounge. No seats are reserved for couples.

intent: 独自去河边，保留自己的时间
Visit the river alone and keep time for yourself
consequence: 河岸路线与返程时间供自由安排，没有人要求陪同或汇报。
The riverside route and return time remain yours to arrange. No one demands company or reports.

scenes.visual: Afternoon museum restoration gallery under glass roof, Lucien Rowan Cassian around public city repair display with blank pins, warm peaceful light
beats: n
下午的修复展厅开放，城市案卷开始向居民归还。
The restoration gallery opens that afternoon as city records begin returning to residents.
n
三份行动记录保留各人的责任，没有写成恋爱功劳。
The three operational records preserve responsibilities without recasting them as romantic merit.
lucien
你不必记得那些片段，才有资格拒绝我。
You do not need to remember those fragments to have the right to refuse me.
rowan
不决定恋爱，也是一份完整的未来。
A future without a romantic decision is still complete.
cassian
自由不是我们救城之后，才赏给你的东西。
Freedom is not something we award you for helping save the city.
exit: 傍晚，Mara在玻璃穹顶登记厅开放新的无期限联系册。

place: 博物馆玻璃穹顶登记厅
scenes.visual: Museum glass dome registry at sunset, Lucien Rowan Cassian stand apart in warm amber light while Mara opens fresh blank registry, unsealed envelopes on table, hopeful freedom
beats: n
日落穿过玻璃穹顶，落在仍未封口的信上。
Sunset passes through the glass dome and falls across the still-unsealed letters.
n
Mara打开新的联系册，不替任何人填写关系。
Mara opens a new contact register without filling in anyone’s relationship.

只记录你现在愿意留下的约定。以后仍可以改变。
We record only the agreements you want now. They may still change later.

三人留在能够听见、又不会挡住出口的位置。
The three men remain within earshot without blocking the exit.

城里的钟继续向前，这次没有最后一分钟。
The city’s clocks move forward. This time there is no final minute.

How do you want to begin this future without a countdown?

intent: 明确选择与Lucien重新建立恋爱关系
Explicitly choose a new romantic relationship with Lucien
consequence: 旧肖像留在档案馆。Lucien将第一次约会的时间留白，等双方共同确定。
The old portraits remain in the archive. Lucien leaves the first date’s time open for both of you to agree.
你们保留各自生活，约定每次亲近都听现在的意愿。
You retain separate lives and agree to hear present wishes before every new intimacy.
下一次相见可以只是喝咖啡，不必拯救整座城市。
The next meeting can simply be coffee. It need not save an entire city.

intent: 明确选择与Rowan建立恋爱与共同生活
Explicitly choose romance and a shared life with Rowan
consequence: 医院恢复夜间急诊。Rowan把一次海边出游留在双方可调整的日程里。
The hospital’s night clinic reopens. Rowan leaves a coastal trip on a schedule both of you can change.
恋爱不替代工作边界，也不要求你负责他的每一次值班。
Romance does not replace work boundaries or make you responsible for every shift.
下一轮复诊与一次日出之约，都是生活的一部分。
The next follow-up and a sunrise together can both belong to ordinary life.

intent: 明确选择与Cassian恋爱并重建信任
Explicitly choose romance with Cassian and rebuild trust
consequence: 猎人团撤销旧血誓，Cassian把责任审查交给独立成员。
The hunters revoke the old blood oath. Cassian submits accountability review to independent members.
你们的关系不替他免除责任；信任可以慢慢重新建立。
Your relationship does not exempt him from responsibility. Trust can be rebuilt slowly.
第一次没有任务的散步，路线由两人共同商量。
The first walk without a mission has a route the two of you can choose together.

intent: 选择独立生活，不建立恋爱关系
Choose an independent life without a romantic relationship
consequence: 联系册保留朋友与公共求助渠道，不登记恋人。
The register retains friends and public support contacts without naming a romantic partner.
没有期限的车票可以买，也可以留待以后。城市不再收取自由的代价。
An open-ended ticket can be bought now or later. The city no longer charges for freedom.
朋友的下一封来信，会先问你愿不愿意收到。
The next letter from a friend will first ask whether you wish to receive it.

intent: 暂不确定恋人，继续以伙伴身份同行
Defer romance and continue together as companions
consequence: 城市修复计划以伙伴身份存档，关系没有被偷偷补全。
The restoration plan records companionship without silently inventing a relationship.
未来可以出现约会，也可以一直只有友谊；没人为等待记账。
There may be dates later, or lasting friendship. No one keeps a debt for waiting.
下一次见面先谈一顿饭，新的日子不需要命运批准。
The next meeting can start with a meal. New days need no permission from fate.
